card.line: Mount Zion is the hill in Jerusalem that David captured and made his city. It later stands for God's people and the heavenly city.

moments.title: David captures the fortress
moments.text: The Jebusites said David could never get in, but David captured the fortress of Zion. He lived there and called it the City of David.

moments.title: The ark is brought up
moments.text: Solomon gathered Israel's leaders to bring the ark of the covenant up from Zion, the City of David. The priests set it in the temple, and the glory of the LORD filled the house.

moments.title: A promise to Hezekiah
moments.text: The LORD answered Hezekiah's prayer about the king of Assyria. He promised that a remnant would go out from Jerusalem and survivors from Mount Zion, and that Assyria would not enter the city.

moments.title: Weeping for Zion
moments.text: In Babylon, God's people sat by the rivers and wept as they remembered Zion. Their captors asked for a song of Zion, but they could not sing it in a foreign land.

moments.title: The Lamb on Mount Zion
moments.text: John saw the Lamb standing on Mount Zion. With Him were 144,000 who had His name and His Father's name written on their foreheads.
